newsitem.title: KENYA: Hundreds of demonstrators take Nairobi streets.
newsitem.headline: Hundreds of demonstrators take Nairobi streets.

text.p: Several hundred supporters of a one-day general strike in Kenya took to the streets of Nairobi, breaking a few shop windows and chanting slogans against President Daniel arap Moi, witnesses said.
They said the youths rampaged through the main city centre at the end of a scantly attended opposition rally called to press the government for constitutional reforms.
"They are now breaking into shops. They are setting up barricades and blocking traffic," a Reuters correspondent at the scene said.
The demonstrations came after opposition supporters at a rally beat to death a man suspected of being a police spy.
Said Athman, a spokesman for the medical charity St Johns, told Reuters the man identified as Gilbert Ahanya Simiyu was pronounced dead on arrival at Nairobi hospital at around 12 p.m. (0900 GMT).
